title: Verbs of Study & Attention: összpontosít, jegyzetel

sections.title: Case government with study verbs
sections.content: You know verbs that govern *-ra / -re* from Unit 3 (*visszatekint* + *-ra/-re*). *összpontosít* works the same way: *összpontosít valamire*, and so does *figyel valamire*.

items.english: We must focus on the difficult exercises.
During class, I always take notes in a notebook.
